text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sway~ sway~... Heheh, both your leaves and 
your height have grown quite a lot, 
haven't they~?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Back again, Bright? No matter how much you 
dote on them and wait, those flowers won't 
bloom until next month at the earliest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Lady Air Groove. Do not worry♪ I 
remember our previous conversation quite 
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's just like you to want to 
keep watch over their growth every step of 
the way. It looks like rain, so head 
inside soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. That will be all for today's 
observations~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I heard from Dober, but your 
patience truly is the real deal. You seem 
like you could wait for a dogtooth violet 
to bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Surely. For that too is a flower with 
a future where it will one day bloom in 
all its glory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, just as these flowers are tended 
by Air Groove-sama, I too am blossoming 
with Trainer-sama's guidance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This year, I shall surely bear the fruit 
of results. Even if someone crosses the 
line ahead of me once, I will shine a step 
ahead the second time~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems the flower of Mejiro 
has found quite a fine caretaker.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She is a dependable person with the 
skill to make grand blossoms bloom~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. Mejiro Bright invited 
me to the garden, saying the flowers had 
bloomed and we should go see them 
together.
